summary: Allowed start windows for the shipment's pickup step.
range: Array of [start,end] Unix-second pairs; each start <= end. Overlapping windows allowed (shared time-window model, C2).
constraints: Each start <= end; non-negative Unix seconds (C2).
businessRules: Pickup must start within a window (or within max_visit_lateness); early arrival waits (C2).
Couples with the delivery window for precedence feasibility (C4).

time_windows defines: Describe time periods within which the shipment pickup should be start. The time periods should be expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Please note that the time periods should not overlap wit…
Each element in time_windows must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: shipments.delivery.time_windows. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: A window with end < start -> 400 input validation failed (C2 shared model; API Facts §4).
testingGuidance: Positive: pickup step served within a single window (C2).
Boundary: instant pickup window [t,t] -> pickup starts exactly at t (C2 edge case).
Negative-validation: a pickup window with end < start -> 400 (C2).
Negative-infeasible: pickup window strictly after the delivery window -> precedence infeasible -> both steps unassigned (C4 edge case).
Interaction: early arrival before the pickup window waits to window start (C2).
Interaction: Infeasible: delivery time window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: two amount [3] shipments onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred by capacity.
Interaction: Precedence: pickup [10:00,11:00], delivery [09:00,09:30] (delivery before pickup) -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: job window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 0, nearest vehicle arrives 09:45 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Interaction: a long wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned (couples with max-duration-distance-cap).
Interaction: Shipment: delivery window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 15, nearest vehicle arrives 09:40 -> accepted within lateness.
Interaction: Break: break time_windows [12:00,13:00], vehicle arrives 12:30 -> break scheduled at 12:30.
